Question: A function \(f\) is defined by \(f(z) = i\overline{z},\) where \(i = \sqrt{-1}\) and \(\overline{z}\) is the complex conjugate of \(z.\) How many values of \(z\) satisfy both \(|z| = 5\) and \(f(z) = z?\)
